title: Grade 2 Science — Wed, Jun 03
description: Plants Around Us — Day 3 of 5: What plants give us
subject: science

questions.question: Which of these do we get from plants?
questions.explanation: Plants give us fruits to eat, along with vegetables, grains and more.

questions.question: The gas that plants give out, which we need to breathe, is:
questions.explanation: Plants release oxygen, the gas all animals and people need to breathe.

questions.question: Wood for making furniture comes from the ____ of trees.
questions.explanation: Wood comes from the trunk (stem) of trees and is used to make furniture.

questions.question: Which of these is a vegetable we get from a plant?
questions.explanation: Potato is a vegetable that grows from a plant.

questions.question: Cotton, used to make clothes, comes from a:
questions.explanation: Cotton comes from the cotton plant and is used to make cloth.

questions.question: Which part of the plant do we eat when we eat spinach?
questions.explanation: Spinach is a leafy vegetable — we eat its leaves.

questions.question: Rice and wheat are examples of:
questions.explanation: Rice and wheat are grains (seeds) that we get from plants and eat as food.

questions.question: Plants are important because they give us:
questions.explanation: Plants give us food to eat and oxygen to breathe, among many other things.

questions.question: Which sweet liquid do we get with the help of plants and bees?
questions.explanation: Bees collect nectar from flowers to make honey, so honey comes with the help of plants.

questions.question: Which part of the plant do we eat when we eat a carrot?
questions.explanation: A carrot is the root of the carrot plant.

questions.question: Medicines for many illnesses are made from:
questions.explanation: Many medicines are made from plants such as neem, tulsi and aloe vera.

questions.question: On a hot day, sitting under a tree feels cool because the tree gives:
questions.explanation: Trees give us shade, which keeps us cool on hot days.

questions.question: Which of these do we NOT get from plants?
questions.explanation: Stone comes from the earth, not from plants. Paper, fruits and wood all come from plants.

questions.question: Sugar that we eat is mostly made from a plant called:
questions.explanation: Sugar is made from the juice of the sugarcane plant.

questions.question: Why should we plant more trees?
options: They give us food, oxygen and shade
questions.explanation: More trees mean more food, more oxygen to breathe and more shade, so we should plant them.
